P01.rationale: There are no human portraits or founder images on this page; it consists entirely of text and icons.

P05.rationale: The page lists five steps but does not contain any framed client portraits or testimonials as requested by the rubric.

P07.rationale: There is no social-proof apparatus such as a press wall, rating cards, or review grid present on this page.

P10.rationale: The typography is standard and functional; there are no oversized decorative typographic elements like giant ghost numerals.

P11.rationale: There are no data-visualisations or charts bound to numbers on this page.

P13.rationale: The background is a flat, solid off-white color without any intentional texture or atmosphere.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos on this page to evaluate for treatment or readability of overlaid text.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockups (phone/laptop) are shown in the composition.

N07.rationale: The imagery consists of simple icons and typography rather than generic stock photography.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the content fills most of the page area effectively.

N10.rationale: Text sits on a clean background without any busy photos or awkward inset gaps.
